MECA.TITLE: Warning Display (Vehicle-to-vehicle Distance Control Mode Unavailable)

ITEM.PTXT: When the self-check function of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly detects dirt on the front of the sensor or on the radar-transmissive grille cover, the single-tone buzzer sounds, the CRUISE operation/warning indicator light blinks, the master warning indicator light illuminates, and "Radar dirty, cleaning required" is displayed on the multi-information display.

When there is a possibility that the detection performance of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly may be reduced due to bad weather, etc., a single buzzer sounds, the CRUISE operation/warning indicator light blinks, the master warning indicator light comes on, and "Bad weather, cruise unavailable" is shown on the multi-information display.
When the wipers are operating at HI.
